entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I need to return something. It's the... VeloBand Pulse sensor I bought.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-886-2155. I got it a couple of weeks ago.

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse, delivered on December 19th. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a personal preference?
Oh, it works fine. I just... I sort of changed my mind. It was a bit of an impulse buy, and honestly, I just don't use it. The whole setup seems a little complicated for me.
I understand. Thank you for clarifying. Looking at the purchase date, I see we are on day 15 since delivery. For the VeloBand Pulse specifically, we have a 10-day return policy.
Ten days? I thought it was 90 days. The website is so confusing. I saw 90 days somewhere... I wouldn't have bought it if I knew that. Can't you just help me? It's still in the box.

I can appreciate the confusion. Our 90-day policy does apply to apparel like jerseys and shoes, but for electronic devices like the Pulse that are worn on the body, there's a stricter 10-day window due to hygiene protocols and the way the device activates and links to a user's account. Because we're past that 10-day mark, I'm unable to process a refund.
So I'm just stuck with it? I don't understand. I'm never going to use it.
Not at all. While a direct return to VeloFit isn't an option in this case, we've created a solution for exactly this situation. We have an official VeloFit Resale Marketplace.
A resale what?

It's a platform we host for our community where you can safely sell your lightly used VeloFit gear to other enthusiasts. Since your Pulse is practically new, it's a very popular item and you can likely recoup most of what you paid. It's much safer than a general auction site.
Oh. So... other people would buy it there?
Absolutely. It's a very active community. I can send you a direct link to the marketplace page. It has a step-by-step guide on how to create a listing. Would that work for you?
I... I think so. That actually sounds like a good idea. Yes, please send me that link. Thank you, Alex.
You're very welcome. I've just sent that link to the email on file. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. Thanks for your help.
Glad I could help find a solution for you. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
